title: Checkout payment authorization: where a declined card is retried vs. abandoned
caption: Reconstructed from API gateway + PSP webhook logs, Q2 2026; n=48,200 checkout attempts, 6.1% soft-decline rate.

spec.dsl:
sequenceDiagram autonumber actor Shopper participant SPA as Checkout SPA participant API as Order API participant PSP as Payment Gateway participant Bank as Issuing Bank Shopper->>SPA: Submit card + place order SPA->>API: POST /orders (cart, payment token) API->>API: Validate cart + reserve inventory API->>PSP: Authorize charge ($148.00) PSP->>Bank: Auth request Bank-->>PSP: Decision alt Approved PSP-->>API: auth_ok (txn_id) API-->>SPA: 201 Created (order confirmed) SPA-->>Shopper: Show confirmation else Soft decline (insufficient funds) PSP-->>API: soft_decline (retryable) API-->>SPA: 402 retry_allowed SPA-->>Shopper: Prompt for another card opt Shopper retries within 15 min Shopper->>SPA: Submit new card SPA->>API: POST /orders (retry) Note right of API: Reuses inventory reservation;
no double hold end else Hard decline (fraud / lost card) PSP-->>API: hard_decline (final) API->>API: Release inventory reservation API-->>SPA: 402 final SPA-->>Shopper: Decline; suggest support end Note over PSP,Bank: 3-D Secure step-up omitted;
handled in a separate flow

semantic_description.level_1_elemental: A UML sequence diagram of a checkout payment authorization across five lifelines: the Shopper actor, the Checkout SPA, the Order API, the Payment Gateway, and the Issuing Bank. Autonumbered messages run top to bottom from order submission through the bank's authorization decision, then split into three branches.
semantic_description.level_2_statistical: Five lifelines and roughly fifteen numbered messages; one self-message (cart validation/inventory reserve), dashed return arrows for responses, and a three-way alt fragment (Approved / Soft decline / Hard decline) with a nested opt fragment for the retry path.
semantic_description.level_3_perceptual: The diagram reads as a single shared trunk down to the bank decision, then visibly forks into three stacked alternative compartments; only the soft-decline compartment loops back upward to the Shopper, making the retry the one branch that re-enters the flow rather than terminating.
semantic_description.level_4_contextual: The soft-decline retry path is the only branch that can still convert; the hard-decline branch explicitly releases the inventory hold, isolating where abandoned-cart inventory is freed versus held for a retry.
semantic_description.short_alt: Five-lifeline checkout auth sequence; bank decision forks into approved, soft-decline-with-retry, and hard-decline branches.
